_comment: The product is an AI sales desk sold to trades. NOTHING here may claim the software already does something it does not — the site is written for an early-access launch, where being straight about what is built is a selling point rather than a weakness. Flip `stage` to "live" once it ships and the copy follows.
name: Foreman
_nameComment: Placeholder. Trade-native, short, not twee — but naming is yours. It appears in the logo, page titles, schema and every CTA; changing it is this line plus assets/logo.svg.
tagline: The AI sales team for trades
description: Foreman answers every enquiry in seconds, qualifies it, builds the quote from your own price book, chases it until you get an answer, and books the survey. The jobs you were losing because you were up a ladder.
stageNotice: Foreman is in early access. We are taking a small number of founding customers, building around how they actually work, and charging them half price for life.
_credentialsComment: Claims about what the SOFTWARE does are fair. Claims about outcomes — 'our customers win 32% more work' — stay out until you have measured them on real accounts.

credentials.label: Live in a week
credentials.detail: Send us your price list and we set it up. No implementation project, no consultant, no six-week onboarding.

credentials.label: You approve every word
credentials.detail: Foreman drafts, you tap approve. Turn that off once you trust it — most people do within a fortnight.

credentials.label: Your price book, your margins
credentials.detail: It quotes from your rates and your terms. It does not invent prices and it does not discount to win.

credentials.label: Works on your phone
credentials.detail: No laptop, no training day. It texts you, you text back. On site that is the whole interface.

credentials.label: Monthly rolling
credentials.detail: No contract, no setup fee, no minimum term. Stop at the end of any month.

credentials.label: Your data stays yours
credentials.detail: Your customers and your prices are never used to train anything, never shared, never sold.
